classes.title: Athletes - Sharp Steps, Defence Revision, Shuffle-Jab
classes.summary: Athletes group (Tue/Fri), 3 athletes. Started late so warm-up skipped. Coordination (tennis ball + step), pivots, sharp full steps, defence revision vs jab and cross with noodles, numbers drill for sharpness, beanbag plank reaction game, shuffle-jab line drills, step 1-2, mixed sequence with noodles then pads, circular padwork, push-ups between. Main faults: leaning on the punch, rear elbow off the body, centre line.
suggestions: Keep a 3-minute compressed warm-up even on late starts (rope or shadow footwork) - the coordination block is not enough to prime the hips and ankles before sharp steps.
Rear elbow: run the shuffle-jab line drill with a tennis ball tucked under the rear armpit - if it drops, the elbow left the body. Same ball they already use for coordination.
Leaning on the punch: set the pad at a distance they can only reach by stepping, not by leaning - ties 'arms long beyond the toes' to the step on the jab.
Centre line: tape a line on the floor for the line drills and have the jab travel along it; noodle held on the centre line as the target.
Next progression: the lateral version of shuffle-jab and step 1-2 (skipped tonight), and defence into counter - catch then jab back, slip then cross (Counter 1-2 off Slip).
Step on the jab: show them 3D Logan's Jab-Forward (lead foot lands with the jab, back foot follows) as the model for sharp steps.

segments.drill_notes: Step + tennis ball bounce and catch: switch step in on the step, catch left hand only, then right hand only. Lateral switch steps (one foot always on the step), left then right hand. Step removed: floor catch normally, then with half step.
Catch the tennis ball between two fingers.
Three defences vs the jab and three vs the cross with noodles: catch, slip, block, step back.
Called numbers: catch-jab, slip-cross, step back 1-2. Worked on sharpness.
Plank, three athletes, coloured beanbags between them. Coach calls a colour - first to snatch it wins, other two do a push-up.

Shuffle while jabbing (forward and back, no lateral today). Shuffle, stop, continue on their own. Three jabs. Cues: arms long beyond the toes, centre line, rear elbow on the body. They lean on the punch.
Step and punch: step on the jab, step on the cross, return. Then mixed: shuffle with three jabs, stop, 1-2 with steps, reversed on the way back.
Same sequence with noodles first, then on pads so they get to hit.

observations.observation: Leaning on the punch - weight goes over the front foot instead of stepping to reach.
Rear elbow comes off the body; hard for them to keep the back elbow in.
Centre line needed constant reinforcement during line drills.
Arms long beyond the toes - cue used throughout shuffle-jab.
Group struggled with step-drag basics — need more warm-up time on footwork
